name: Traversal verbs
notes: Climbing and ledge capabilities the sim checks today (src/sim/climb: surfaces.ts and mantle.ts name these ids). Mantling and ladders, ropes and ivy need none. The testbed grants verb.climb.ledge to the player until class data (mw-e19.4) grants each class its kit; ADR-0004 makes rough-wall climbing the thief's.

capabilities.name: Ledge Hang
capabilities.description: Grab a ledge up to hand reach, hang from it, shimmy along it and lower off an edge into a hang (mw-e02.12).

capabilities.name: Climb Rough Stone
capabilities.description: Jump at a rough stone or timber wall and climb it (mw-e02.13).

capabilities.name: Climb Sheer Faces
capabilities.description: Climb a sheer face with claws or a climbing tool (mw-e10). Nothing grants it yet.

capabilities.name: Grip Ice
capabilities.description: Keep hold of a frozen surface or ledge instead of slipping off (ice tools, future). Nothing grants it yet.
